quests.title: Frontier Access: the damaged stone and Jirachi (after the final Hall of Fame)

acquisitions.conditions: After the final Hall of Fame, finish the legendary investigation story through Crystal’s return to Cherrygrove first. Repair the Frontier Access stone seven times, defeat the Rocket pair, then accept Jirachi with a free party slot. Each repair accepts Yes even without a Star Piece.
